name: sorokeep-ttl-codelens
description: Shows inline TTL/expiry status for Stellar contract IDs referenced in your code, read read-only from the local sorokeep SQLite database.

sorokeep.dbFilePath.description: Path to the local sorokeep SQLite database (usually ~/.sorokeep/sorokeep.db). ${HOME} is expanded to the user's home directory.

sorokeep.dbReadMode.description: How to open the sorokeep database. 'readonly' opens read-only (safe with a WAL-mode daemon writer); 'immutable' ignores the WAL and -shm files for environments where even read-only open is blocked, at the cost of possibly stale data.

sorokeep.enableCodeLens.description: Enable inline TTL CodeLens on Stellar contract IDs.
